entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane of Greek-mythic adventure watched over by a pantheon of fifteen gods, filled with heroes and monsters.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The realm in which the gods of Theros reside.

entities.name: Gods of Theros
entities.description: A pantheon of fifteen gods, five core mono-colored gods and ten minor two-color gods, who can take many forms and walk among mortals.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The white god of Theros who strives to make Elspeth his champion.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The blue god of Theros, god of the sea.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The black god of Theros, god of the dead.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: The red god of Theros, god of the forge.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The green god of Theros.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god whose snake priests' temple heals Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives on Theros after leaving New Phyrexia, defeats a hydra, and is courted by Heliod.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr born on Theros and planeswalker who seeks to enter the Therosian pantheon as a god.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A new planeswalker printed in the set.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A companion Elspeth recalls from New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A companion Elspeth recalls from New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A companion Elspeth recalls from New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A companion Elspeth recalls from New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A companion Elspeth recalls from New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Hydra of Theros
entities.description: A deadly hydra that has killed many Therosian heroes and is defeated by Elspeth.

entities.name: Satyrs
entities.description: Xenagos's clan of partying satyrs.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Elspeth leaves before arriving on Theros.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: The place where Elspeth had a peaceful life before the Conflux.

events.summary: Elspeth planeswalks from New Phyrexia to Theros, where snake priests of Pharika restore her strength.
events.quote: After planeswalking away from New Phyrexia , Elspeth finds herself on a vaguely familiar plane, Theros.

events.summary: Elspeth kills a deadly hydra in a bitter battle, winning Heliod's notice.
events.quote: After a bitter battle, she emerges the victor.

events.summary: Heliod, noticing her feat, strives to make Elspeth his champion.
events.quote: Heliod, taking notice of her feat, now strives to make Elspeth his champion.

events.summary: Xenagos's planeswalker spark ignites and he leaves Theros, later returning with a desire for power.
events.quote: until his planeswalker spark ignited and he was able to travel away from Theros

events.summary: Xenagos resolves to enter the Therosian pantheon as a god.
events.quote: his mission now is to enter the Therosian pantheon as a god
